fields.objection: The reported amplitude boundary is on the tested Gaussian-defect branch, with fixed material and perfect interfaces. It is not a global optimum over all defects or installed-hull safety proof.
fields.proposed_fix: Validate the actual defect spectrum and coupled failure modes; test the built shell before assigning installed SF.

qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma.
